children: Taiwan's central bank said on Tuesday that strong technology demand would drive exports into next year, though economic growth in 2027 will likely moderate after this year's high base.
Taiwan is a major semiconductor manufacturer and home to TSMC
, the world's largest contract chipmaker and supplier to companies like Nvidia
, which are powering the trend towards AI.
Here are some details from the central bank's report:

"Looking ahead to next year, demand for emerging technology applications is expected to remain strong, which should continue to drive Taiwan's exports and private investment," the central bank said in a report to lawmakers
However, because this year's base for economic growth is relatively high, the bank said it forecasts the economy to expand 5.82% next year, "which still represents steady growth"
The central bank last month raised its 2026 economic growth forecast to 11.48% from the previous prediction of 9.45% given in June
In its report to lawmakers, the central bank said geopolitical risks and weather conditions are the main uncertainties affecting the future trajectory of inflation in Taiwan
